description: Export legacy time-window tracking data for the authenticated SocialSeal user. Always reuse the workspaceId from the lookup that returned the selected group or tracking item; numeric IDs are not sufficient workspace context. Fulfilled as an export artifact: returns download_url plus a read_token for in-session paginated reads with socialseal_read_export_chunk when the URL cannot be fetched. For ranked discoverability, use socialseal_export_report with reportType search_results_enriched.

body.description: Legacy export body. Provide group_id or tracking_item_id, plus required time_period such as "30d".

groupId.description: CamelCase alias for group_id, a numeric tracking_group id.

group_id.description: Numeric tracking_group id for the legacy tracking CSV export. Pair it with the workspaceId from the same group lookup.

timePeriod.description: CamelCase alias for time_period; use "30d" unless the user asked for another window.

time_period.description: Required legacy export window, for example "30d".

tracking_item_id.description: Tracking item id for a single-item legacy tracking CSV export.

workspaceId.description: Workspace that owns the selected group or tracking item. Reuse the workspaceId from the lookup that returned the ID.

groupId.description: Convenience alias for body.group_id, a numeric tracking_group id.

group_id.description: Convenience field for body.group_id, a numeric tracking_group id.

timePeriod.description: Required legacy export window unless supplied in body.time_period, for example "30d".

time_period.description: Required legacy export window unless supplied in body.timePeriod, for example "30d".

workspaceId.description: Required explicit workspace from the same lookup that returned the selected group or tracking item (unless body.workspaceId is provided). Workspace defaults are never used for exports.

name: socialseal_export_tracking_data
title: Export SocialSeal tracking data
